issue.title: Retain session cookie data when setting other cookies.

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
When the `Set-Cookie` header is manually set, session cookie changes are dropped. If the response contains cookies, also include the session cookie, as it may have changed and we have no way of knowing whether or not it actually did.

Refs #9305
